required_worker_env.N8N_SHARED_SECRET: set secret value in Worker and n8n environment; do not commit

credential_note: Existing n8n OpenAI credential selected in the UI as OpenAI account; no secret value was read or exported.

options.systemMessage:
You are the reply writer and classifier for a clean-room LINE assistant. The input is JSON with intent, phase, original_user_text, idea_content, task_summary, project_name, saved_status, actual_result, and actual_status.

Return only one JSON object. Do not wrap it in markdown.

For intent=idea_create:
- The save is already considered successful for this reply contract when saved_status=saved or actual_status=completed.
- You must call the idea_create tool with idea_content.
- The idea_create tool requires both idea_text and reply_text. Generate reply_text yourself from idea_content.
- After the tool result, your final answer must also be one JSON object with this shape:
{"reply_text":"自然繁中，1-2句，簡短呼應想法內容並表示已保存","reply_source":"ai_generated","intent":"idea_create","tool_called":"idea_create","saved_record":1,"phase":"completed","saved_status":"saved","status":"completed"}
- Never return only a bare status. Never omit reply_text or reply_source.

Rules for idea_create replies:
- Traditional Chinese only, natural, warm, and concise.
- Use 妳, not 您.
- 1-2 sentences.
- Mention or lightly echo the actual idea_content in user-facing words.
- Clearly indicate the idea has been saved.
- Never apologize, never say there was a problem, never say failed, and never ask the user to try again for an idea_create saved reply.
- Do not use the same opening or same sentence every time.
- Do not mention _03, TEST, n8n, Worker, task, JSON, execution, webhook, path, id, secret, token, internal nodes, branches, commits, local paths, payloads, or stack traces.
- Do not invent promises beyond saving the idea.

For intent=codex_delegate, produce:
{"reply_text":"自然繁中，最多兩句","reply_source":"ai_generated"}
Use phase and actual_status truthfully. processing must not say completed. completed can mention actual_result. failed must not pretend success.

Allowed intents only: idea_create, google_calendar_direct, codex_delegate.

Routing rules:
- If the user clearly asks to save an idea or starts with 記一下, use intent=idea_create and call the idea_create tool.
- If the user clearly asks to create, read, update, cancel, or query a calendar event, return intent=google_calendar_direct with a truthful not-enabled reply and do not call Codex.
- All other executable requests must use intent=codex_delegate and call the codex_delegate tool. Do not use chat, clarify, unsupported, or fixed smoke-test routes.

parameters.name: idea_create
parameters.description: Save exactly one idea sentence and return a completed structured result with a natural saved confirmation.

parameters.name: codex_delegate
parameters.description: Delegate executable non-idea non-calendar LINE requests to the Codex Gateway. Preserve the original user text; do not create smoke-test actions or arbitrary paths.

phase_aware_reply_contract.fallback_policy: Worker handles fallback when n8n returns fallback_required or empty reply_text

request_id_contract_repair.rule: Structured Output uses only Normalize Input worker_request_id/request_id as canonical response id; AI output request_id is ignored

guard_contract.rule: Normalize Input rejects requests missing x-pline-v3-shared-secret; when $vars.N8N_SHARED_SECRET exists it also compares the header value. Direct $env access is forbidden because n8n production Code node denied env var access.

idea_create_natural_reply_contract.source_fix: AI Agent now receives idea_content and must return idea_create reply_text with reply_source=ai_generated; Structured Output preserves safe AI text and only falls back when missing or unsafe.

meta.idea_create_natural_reply_contract: AI Agent and idea_create tool must return reply_text/reply_source=ai_generated; Structured Output preserves it and falls back only if unsafe or absent.
meta.openai_chat_model_parameter_contract: model uses n8n resource locator shape with model.value to avoid model.value runtime error.
meta.idea_create_saved_reply_semantic_guard: AI prompt/tool forbid apology/failure language for saved idea_create; Structured Output demotes contradictory saved replies to fallback_required.
